clippings.speaker: Chad Stahelski
clippings.quote: And Keanu was instrumental in guiding us through our 1,000 mistakes a day we'd make.
clippings.title: 'John Wick' director Chad Stahelski talks friendship with 'older brother' Keanu Reeves
clippings.context: Explaining how Reeves helped him and the writers with storytelling while making the John Wick films, in a Good Morning America interview timed to Chapter 4.

clippings.speaker: Chad Stahelski
clippings.quote: Keanu literally writes 90 percent of his own dialogue. We write in the fillers and he will go through and adjust.
clippings.title: John Wick: Chapter 4 director Chad Stahelski breaks down that epic Berlin nightclub battle
clippings.context: Answering a question about what it has been like collaborating with Reeves, in an A.V. Club interview about Chapter 4.

clippings.speaker: Chad Stahelski
clippings.quote: Keanu actually can ride a motorcycle better than a lot of stuntmen.
clippings.title: John Wick director on doing proper action and sh*t with Keanu Reeves
clippings.context: Explaining why riding a motorcycle at 65 mph is not a stunt for Reeves, in a triple j Breakfast interview from the Chapter 3 press cycle.

clippings.speaker: Chad Stahelski
clippings.quote: Keanu Reeves and John Wick are the same guy.
clippings.title: 'John Wick' Franchise Director Chad Stahelski Talks Shooting Action And Building Characters In A Spoiler-Heavy Interview
clippings.context: Explaining why audiences read Reeves's own body in the fight choreography as the character's, in a spoiler-heavy /Film interview.

clippings.speaker: Keanu Reeves
clippings.quote: I'm getting a little bit better at them. I'm still not very good, but I try really hard. And that allows the director, with his invention, to do more.
clippings.title: Keanu Reeves Interview: John Wick Chapter 4
clippings.context: Reeves on how his improved martial arts let Stahelski invent more complex action, in a Screen Rant interview.

clippings.speaker: Keanu Reeves
clippings.quote: Sitting down with the director, visionary Chad Stahelski, "What can we do next?"
clippings.title: Keanu Reeves Interview: John Wick Chapter 4
clippings.context: Reeves on his favorite part of the process, the creative sessions with Stahelski, in the same Screen Rant interview.

notes: Reeves-side quotes are thin: Collider and IndieWire were not usable (blocked or redirected to a licensing gateway), and Deadline was skipped for the same reason. Collider and Deadline Stahelski quotes were not used because they could not be checked verbatim.
